# Ask your happy customers for a testimonial, and show the ones you approve

> Collect customer testimonials with a link, approve the ones you want, and show them on your site with one script tag. Consent stored with every entry. Open source, MIT, one-click self-deploy, no monthly fee.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
